hero.tagline: Safe, Clean & Comfortable Student Hostel in Sadiqabad
hero.subtext: The premier residence for students and working professionals. Fully furnished rooms, hygienic 3-time mess, high-speed WiFi, 24/7 security, and power backup.

highlights.title: Why Students Choose Us
highlights.subtitle: Everything you need for a focused, comfortable and secure stay in Sadiqabad
highlights.safeDesc: 24/7 security guard, CCTV cameras, and disciplined quiet environment for peace of mind.
highlights.cleanDesc: Daily room and washroom cleaning, regular pest control, and fresh purified drinking water.
highlights.affordableDesc: Honest pricing with no hidden charges. Flexible mess options and refundable security deposit.
highlights.comfortableDesc: Furnished beds with quality mattresses, study tables, wardrobes, and high-speed fiber internet.

rooms.title: Rooms & Monthly Fees

rooms.note1: Monthly fees must be submitted between the 1st and 10th of each calendar month.
rooms.note2: Security deposit is 100% refundable at the time of leaving after 15 days advance notice.
rooms.note3: Admission fee is a one-time registration charge and is non-refundable.
